decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core pipeline-component business in a growing market, the flanged dismantling joint fits its customization and infrastructure customer base and shows no sign of underperformance.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket broadens the firm's established support and fabrication offer for project customers and was given its own webpage, suggesting it is commercially relevant enough to retain.

The pipe support bracket is a natural add-on to the firm's existing metal fabrication and pipeline-accessory range and supports its strategy of expanding individualized solutions for infrastructure projects.
